cargo_registry.content: crates.io index cache and .crate files consumed by the offline crosvm build

toolchains.sysroot: Ubuntu 26.04 arm64 development packages with the GunyahVM 3D graphics stage under opt/gunyahvm-3d/graphics

source.comment: the macOS branch on 11-18, which main fast-forwards to; its configs/env.lock.json pins every other source

firmware.comment: the firmware GunyahVM 1.3 to 1.5 shipped as a binary: edk2-gunyah droidvm 90c4d52 with the virtio-gpu queue size fix (the macOS branch's 67b9dba has an equivalent), ECAM PCI

boot.bootargs: debug=0x14e -no_slto_panic ml-timeout-lock-panic-scale=40 tlto_us=0 -apfs_shared_datavolume offline-apfs-load=1 offline-hid-input=1 offline-hid-home=1 sheng-touch-hid=1 offline-key-events=1 sheng-aks=1 sheng-aks-sls=3 sheng-smp=1 droidvm-monitor=1000 droidvm-data-persist=2 owner-staged-apps=1 droidvm-disable-jobs=com.apple.watchdogd,com.apple.identityservicesd,com.apple.locationd,com.apple.CommCenter -v rootauth=0 panic-spin=1 mac-amfi-launch-permissive=1 ml-timeout-lock-scale=40 droidvm-timebase-hz=24000000 vgpu-3d=1 stderr-log=1 msgbuf=1048576 ml-timeout-debug-ack-scale=100 ca-triple-buffer=1 ca-free-wakeup=1 serial=3

guest-symvers.content: Module.symvers of a full build of the pinned guest kernel source and config
